<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018–19 Arab protests]]
**At least five people are killed in a second day of spontaneous [[2018–19 Iraqi protests|protests]] against unemployment, government corruption and lack of basic services in [[Iraq]]. Police say they have "lost control" of the city of [[Nassiriya]] after exchanging gunfire with protesters. [[Curfew]]s are imposed on the Iraqi cities of [[Baghdad]], Nassiriya, [[Amarah]] and [[Hillah]]. [https://www.apnews.com/90e9ce3ac90a4a7294eb233da7fd6b1d (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests/gunfights-rage-in-southern-iraq-protests-spread-nationwide-idUSKBN1WH0YF (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*The [[World Trade Organization]] authorizes the [[United States]] to impose about US$7.5 billion in tariffs on goods from the [[European Union]] every year. The WTO started the probe in 2005 after the United States complained that European subsidies to [[Airbus]] damage [[Boeing]] airplane sales. [https://www.npr.org/2019/10/02/766404561/wto-says-u-s-can-hit-eu-with-7-5-billion-in-tariffs-over-airbus-subsidies (NPR)]
**The United States announces a tariff of 10% on European-made Airbus planes and 25% on a range of goods, set to take effect on 18 October. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-wto-aircraft/u-s-widens-trade-war-with-tariffs-on-european-planes-cheese-whisky-to-punish-subsidies-idUSKBN1WH0SI (Reuters)]
*American retailer [[Bed Bath & Beyond Inc.|Bed Bath & Beyond]] announces it will close 60 stores by the end of the year due to declining profits. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2019/10/02/bed-bath-beyond-closing-60-stores-coming-months/3847126002/ (''USA Today'')]
* A [[foreign exchange]] trader, [[Rohan Ramchandani]], has filed a lawsuit against [[Citigroup]]. Ramchandani won acquittal last year after criminal charges of market manipulation. He claims that the charges were instigated by his former employer in order to mitigate the regulatory consequences for its own misbehavior. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-citigroup-forex-ramchandani/london-forex-trader-sues-citigroup-over-malicious-forex-prosecution-idUSKBN1WH1Y2 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Following yesterday's collapse of [[Nanfang'ao Bridge]] in [[Su'ao]], Taiwan, onto fishing boats, [[search and rescue|rescuers]] recover four bodies. Three are identified as foreign fishermen, with a fourth corpse unidentified. Two people remain missing. [https://www.dw.com/en/death-toll-rises-in-taiwan-bridge-collapse/a-50652949 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[2019 Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress crash]]
**A [[World War II]]-era [[Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress|B-17]] crashes near [[Bradley International Airport]] in the U.S. state of [[Connecticut]], killing at least seven of the 13 people on board. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/vintage-b-17-plane-crashes-erupts-flames-bradley-international-airport-n1061161 (NBC)]
*[[Schoharie limousine crash]]
**The [[National Transportation Safety Board]] of the [[United States]], as part of its investigation, issues a series of recommendations to the [[National Highway Traffic Safety Administration]] asking it to mandate improved seatbelt and construction standard for [[stretch limousines]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-limos-safety/u-s-agency-should-require-limo-safety-standards-after-deadly-crash-ntsb-idUSKBN1WH1ZI (Reuters)]
*At least 14 people are killed after an illegal [[gold mine]] collapses in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]'s [[Maniema]] province. Search efforts are underway for others who could be trapped. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-49912811 (BBC News)]
*[[Star City fire]]
**A fire razed [[Star City (amusement park)|Star City]], an amusement park in [[Pasay]], Philippines in a suspected arson attack early morning. [https://uk.news.yahoo.com/fire-destroys-theme-park-philippines-020000317.html?guccounter=1&guce_referrer=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ29vZ2xlLmNvbS8&guce_referrer_sig=AQAAAIyKONHM6DJEuI5AbMIXnewjq2NB5OfNqC8M_IpPUk70zBftcKpINjrIYacgoJHzovc9TapRtxEG9zyMSsMcR1gmf2oW27k-LHaf5Fr2svRnxmVanam28O9QzO60sU7XvW7092lZf4vbmZSnmm5Dwt92ZrRKlcWLTOr4d_lIOyzQ (Yahoo! News UK)]

;International relations
*[[Japan–North Korea relations]], [[List of North Korean missile tests|North Korean missile tests]]
**[[Prime Minister of Japan|Japanese Prime Minister]] [[Shinzō Abe]] condemns in the strongest terms the latest [[North Korea]]n missile tests and says they clearly violate [[United Nations Security Council]] resolutions. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-49902182  (BBC News)]
**North Korean [[Korean Central News Agency|state media]] says the country has successfully tested a new type of [[submarine-launched ballistic missile]] (SLBM) off the coast of [[Wonsan]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/north-korea-fires-submarine-launched-missile-state-media/a-50685521 (Deutsche Welle)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles/north-korea-says-successfully-tested-new-submarine-launched-ballistic-missile-kcna-idUSKBN1WH2GS (Reuters)]
*U.S. Secretary of State [[Mike Pompeo]] speaks out about [[Freedom of religion in China|China's religious freedom]] violations during a visit to the [[Vatican City|Vatican]]. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/at-vatican-secretary-mike-pompeo-highlights-chinese-religious-freedom-violations-62073 (Catholic News Agency)]

;Law and crime
*[[Corruption in Israel]]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] faces a [[pre-trial hearing|pretrial hearing]] regarding the charges against him in [[Investigations involving Benjamin Netanyahu#Case 4000|Case 4000]], one of the three corruption cases in which the [[Attorney General of Israel|Israeli Attorney General]] [[Avichai Mandelblit]] decided to indict him, pending a hearing. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/02/israel-pm-benjamin-netanyahu-faces-pre-trial-corruption-hearing (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Internet censorship in Singapore]]
**The Protection from Online Falsehoods and Manipulation Act (POFMA), a law giving the Singaporean government more powers to stop the spread of designated falsehoods and [[fake news]], goes into effect. Rights groups like [[Human Rights Watch]] and journalists worry the law could be used to stifle dissent and free expression. [https://www.npr.org/2019/10/02/766399689/fake-news-law-goes-into-effect-in-singapore-worrying-free-speech-advocates (NPR)]
*[[2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal]], [[Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump]]
**A whistleblower who filed a complaint against [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] over a phone conversation with [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelensky]] sought guidance from the [[United States House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence|House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence]] prior to the filing, Representative [[Adam Schiff]]'s office says, but denies seeing the complaint in advance. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/02/politics/whistleblower-intelligence-committee-complaint/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Immigration policy of the first Donald Trump administration|Immigration policy of Donald Trump]]
**The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Donald Trump administration]] says it is preparing to broadly expand [[DNA]] collection from migrants in U.S. detention. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/trump-admin-broadly-expand-dna-collection-migrants-custody-n1061471 (NBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[Bernie Sanders 2020 presidential campaign]]
**U.S. Senator [[Bernie Sanders]] suspends campaigning for the [[2020 United States presidential election|2020 U.S. presidential election]] "until further notice" after the discovery of artery blockage during a medical evaluation for [[chest pain|chest discomfort]] results in surgery. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/02/politics/bernie-sanders-artery-blockage-2020/index.html (CNN)]
